query: What in an incident's description tends to signal it's a hardware problem?

per_column.name: is_hardware_incident
per_column.rationale: This is a direct restatement of the focus variable hardware_incident itself, not an external associational variable. Grouping the focus against itself yields no informative relationship.

per_column.name: incident_domain
per_column.rationale: Well-separated, interpretable categories (hardware, software_application, database, network, vpn, etc.). However, it partially overlaps the focus since 'hardware' is one of its levels, making it somewhat circular; still, the non-hardware categories provide meaningful contrast for segmentation.

per_column.name: hardware_failure_mode
per_column.rationale: Interpretable failure-mode categories (not_functioning, connection_failure, not_powering_on, overheating, etc.) that are strongly associated with hardware. NULLs concentrate on non-hardware cases, so this segments the focus meaningfully, though it is largely defined only when hardware=true (near-tautological presence).

per_column.name: software_component_involved
per_column.rationale: Clear, human-readable software categories (database_client, os_update, vpn_client, office_suite). Its presence/NULL pattern is a good complementary signal that an incident is NOT hardware, supporting contrastive exploration.

per_column.name: recurrence_signal
per_column.rationale: A clean binary (true/false) external attribute that can be cross-tabulated against hardware vs non-hardware incidents to explore whether recurrence associates with hardware problems.

per_column.name: scope_context
per_column.rationale: Interpretable spatial/scope categories (user_workstation, server_room, individual_device, building_wide) that can be segmented and compared against the focus to reveal where hardware incidents cluster.

judge.rationale: The set is largely strong for exploratory analysis: recurrence_signal, scope_context, software_component_involved, and the failure/domain columns provide interpretable, well-separated categories that a human can group and cross-tabulate against the hardware focus. Weaknesses: is_hardware_incident is a pure restatement of the focus and adds nothing, and incident_domain / hardware_failure_mode are partially circular (they contain 'hardware' as a level or are defined only for hardware cases), reducing genuine associational independence. Enough independent, interpretable segmentations remain to support meaningful relationship discovery, so informativeness is good but not maximal.
